limitations: One native worker; not multiworker/production qualification.
Process checks cannot exclude brief intervening render activity.
Only supported primary fixed-sample, empty-AOV diffuse direct-light calculations are offloaded; native shadows and film remain unchanged.
Cancellation check also exercises bounded neighbor selection; timings use FIFO.
